run_local_evaluation: run a local evaluation of a Habitat agent in the configured environment and return metrics
run_remote_evaluation: run a remote evaluation of a Habitat agent through the challenge evaluation server
create_benchmark: create a Benchmark instance from config paths to evaluate agents locally or remotely
evaluate_agent: evaluate a Habitat agent in the configured environment and return aggregated metrics dictionary
get_episode_metrics: get the metrics from the environment after an episode completes during local evaluation
